components: Compensating transactions: starts a business workflow
Compensating transactions: commits one local step
Compensating transactions: commits the next local step
links: report control data to Workflow coordinator

steps: An earlier local transaction reserves inventory.
A later step fails after the reservation is visible.
An idempotent compensation releases the reservation under current business rules.
The workflow ledger records success or escalates an irreconcilable compensation.

lesson.scenario: A bakery cancels a wedding order after flour was allocated and a courier deposit was paid.

steps.title: Commit the ingredient allocation
steps.narration: The pantry removes 20 kg from free stock for WO-55.
steps.outcome: The allocation is a committed business fact, not an open database transaction.
steps.invariant: Compensation must respect current business reality rather than erase history.

steps.title: Pay the courier deposit
steps.narration: A second local transaction transfers the nonzero delivery deposit.
steps.outcome: Two effects must be counteracted if the order is canceled.
steps.invariant: Every reverse action has a stable idempotency key.

steps.title: Record customer cancellation
steps.narration: The customer cancels after 5 kg was already mixed, changing what restoration is possible.
steps.outcome: Exact rollback is impossible because consumed flour cannot be un-mixed.
steps.invariant: The compensating plan is based on present state and domain policy.

steps.title: Refund the deposit idempotently
steps.narration: Refund key REF-DEP-55 returns $60; a retry observes the existing journal row.
steps.outcome: The courier balance is restored without a double refund.
steps.invariant: Repeating REF-DEP-55 produces the same single financial effect.

steps.title: Return what remains
steps.narration: The pantry returns 15 usable kilograms and records 5 kilograms as cancellation waste.
steps.outcome: The order resolves honestly: money restored, reusable stock returned, waste retained.
steps.invariant: Completion records both successful compensation and irrecoverable residual effects.
